object.attr: derived: CF-S16, CF-S17, D9. Anything else is ignored today, so an object moved aside vanishes, and a name that matches only without case reads differently per system and escapes the suspect rule for figures. Dot names cover .gitkeep, draw.io's backups and Mellon's temporary files. Decided on 2026-11-10 (Q-S6).
object.description: If a document's folder holds a file or folder whose name, letter case included, the on-disk format doesn't define and doesn't start with a dot, Mellon shall report a validation error naming the entry.
